capabilities.description: Ingests the uploaded BOQ and contract excerpt as immutable source of record: line items P1-P5 and E1-E5 with units, quantities, and SAR rates, plus contract parameters from Clauses 4.2, 8.2, 8.7, 11.1 and 14.3. Provides the priced bill and clause library that every other capability reads from.

Builds Interim Payment Certificates against measured BOQ quantities (earthworks E1-E5, preliminaries P1-P5), applies 5% retention per Clause 14.3 to each certificate, tracks the 50% release at Taking-Over and the remaining 50% at end of the 365-day Defects Notification Period, and records the 10% pe

Tracks elapsed days against the 730-day Time for Completion (Clause 8.2), computes delay-damages exposure at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, enforces the 10% cap (Clause 8.7), and shows days remaining, days in delay, and current capped exposure against each progress claim.

Maintains Inspection and Test Plans and inspection records for earthworks and preliminaries activities (e.g. compaction of E3 imported granular fill, geotextile placement E5, trench excavation E4), links each ITP hold point to the BOQ item it evidences, and gates progress-claim measurement on record

Central register of project documents -- the contract excerpt, the BOQ, drawings, ITPs, certificates, and correspondence -- with revision control, hashing for integrity, and provenance so any certified quantity or clause interpretation can be traced back to document:harbourline_contract.pdf or docum

Where a claimed amount, ITP acceptance, or delay position cannot be grounded in the uploaded contract or BOQ, the capability refuses to certify, raises a query to the contract administrator, and routes the item for review rather than letting it flow into the certificate.
